purpose: single-stream local runtime diagnostic, not a scientific or trading score

messages.content: Output only a CSV table with exactly 200 data rows. Header: i,square,cube. For each integer i from 1 through 200 in ascending order, write i,i*i,i*i*i as decimal integers. Do not abbreviate, omit rows, add prose, or use a code fence.

measurements: approximate decode tokens per second only when telemetry is bound

interpretation.early_stop_or_length_mismatch: report actual output length and finish; do not normalize to 512 or attribute speed solely to speculation
interpretation.no_token_ids: do not infer target token or acceptance rates from decoded text
interpretation.failed_call: keep denominator and no speed score
